mapper.insert: INSERT INTO verification_record ( user_id, original_filename, saved_path, detect_status, final_score, explanation_text, detailed_reason, not_applicable_reason, overlay_source ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{originalFilename}, #{savedPath}, #{detectStatus}, #{finalScore}, #{explanationText}, #{detailedReason}, #{notApplicableReason}, #{overlaySource} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, original_filename AS originalFilename, saved_path AS savedPath, detect_status AS detectStatus, final_score AS finalScore, explanation_text AS explanationText, detailed_reason AS detailedReason, not_applicable_reason AS notApplicableReason, overlay_source AS overlaySource, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt FROM verification_record WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, user_id AS userId, original_filename AS originalFilename, saved_path AS savedPath, detect_status AS detectStatus, final_score AS finalScore, explanation_text AS explanationText, detailed_reason AS detailedReason, not_applicable_reason AS notApplicableReason, overlay_source AS overlaySource, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt FROM verification_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id DESC
